listing.name: Hexen (Crispy Doom family)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native source-port family with current executable packages. Limits: Maintained Doom-family source ports; separate executables and IWAD contracts per game, not Boom/ZDoom compatibility. Upstream platforms: Latest frozen7.2 Windows release ZIPs explicitly win64/x86-64, separately for Doom/Heretic/Hexen/Strife. macOS Homebrew/MacPorts and Linux distro/source routes; CPU follows selected package/build. Original data: Source-data contract remains Unknown in the retained Crispy Doom root README for Hexen. Establish the corresponding original game IWAD(s), accepted retail/shareware/demo edition and revision before offering setup. The Doom shareware DOOM1.WAD route documented there must not be treated as the full Hexen data set. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
